scope: Historical 132-callback native bridge closure baseline and conservative TU117 bootstrap route audit; not a final production closure or whole-program call-graph proof.

target.first_hardware_checkpoint: one combined package after integration; no implied admission

groups.review: Diagnostics may be entered on ordinary success messages and every error/unwind path. Never omit them on the assumption that initialization succeeds. The local development change implements actual nv_dev_vprintf/nv_log_error output and fatal os_bug_check; this baseline does not claim the other three implementations.

RmInitAdapter calls RmInitAcpiMethods before GSP boot. The methods initializer/uninitializer is not excluded by a non-console GPU. An explicit no-RM-ACPI-events profile can follow the original nv-acpi.c disabled branch; that is a selected unavailable feature, not evidence that the laptop has no ACPI, and not a PM reference.

The device owner must hold real platform power independently of RM dynamic-PM policy. Console guards are based on rm_get_uefi_console_status computed by original RM, not merely a zero-initialized client_managed_console field. Disabling runtime D3 requires real RM registry state/readback and complete entry-route audit.

TU117 PCI identity is not a Tegra SoC display device. Concrete guards are present in unix_intr.c and osinit.c; final admission must also verify original nv_state facts and resulting GPU properties. Hardware identity alone does not erase retained linker imports or all generic OS wrappers.

A first GSP bootstrap may expose no user clients, mappings or event recipients. That is an interface policy requiring sealed entry routes and RM kernel-client call-graph review. nv_get_ctl_state appears in multiple kernel entry wrappers; generic user-path labels alone are insufficient to exclude it.

Only project-owned system-memory DMA is currently implemented. Imported pages, Linux dma_buf/SGT, peer windows, UVM scheduling and fabric capabilities require real ownership or a proved unreachable feature path. Refusing one allocation request must preserve all outputs and unwind correctly; that does not implement mapping.

These are host primitives used by the original NVLink library. A no-NVLink hardware profile may skip training, but original global initialization may still construct common library state. NvLinkDisable registry policy is not a proof that all six host callbacks are unreachable.

Do not publish invented NUMA, page-reference, physical-memory or EGM data. Generic os.c retained wrappers do not establish actual runtime calls. Each needed route requires real Darwin VM/device facts or an audited unsupported subsystem.

Linux procfs capability directories/fds and temporary-file interfaces have no automatic Darwin equivalent. RM global construction/teardown must be reviewed separately from userspace request entry. A non-console policy does not exclude them.

Runtime guest/VFIO operations and compile-time GRID-build facts are different contracts. os_is_grid_supported is used directly when preparing GSP bootstrap flags, even on a physical GPU; the correct value must come from the actual selected build configuration.

PCI BIF reset, hot removal, cache maintenance, CXL and legacy port I/O are distinct policies. TU117 PCI identity does not imply firmware/VBIOS paths are unreachable. Legacy console VBIOS calls must be excluded through actual initialization path evidence before leaving void/scalar callbacks absent.

reviewed_branch_anchors.implication: ACPI method initialization is before the GSP boot block; non-console admission does not skip it.
Setting the property to bypass real initialization is not an implementation.
Original driver explicitly supports no RM ACPI events/methods; an equivalent selected Darwin policy may return no RM handles and unsupported methods, without asserting hardware ACPI absence.
Actual build facts remain required even when virtualization request entry is disabled.
GRID state is selected build configuration, not a fabricated hardware-detection Boolean.
Project context initialization alone does not determine the later original console branch.
Actual non-SoC facts and original GPU property can guard SoC IRQ callbacks; all other SoC wrappers still require separate review.
A runtime D3-off profile must publish and read back actual original registry state and hold independent Darwin PM ownership.
The planned initial policy uses original documented NEVER value, not an invented numeric shortcut.
Original NvLinkDisable=1 suppresses initialization/training, but does not by itself eliminate NVLink library host primitives.
